name: @aifirst/content
description: Canonical AI First book content, plus the shared loader and prompt matcher used by the aifirst CLI and the AI First VS Code extension.
//exports: The `bun` condition points at TypeScript source so the aifirst CLI can consume
this package straight from a git ref with no build step -- which is what makes
`bun install` work in CI, where there is no sibling checkout to build.
`default` keeps the compiled CommonJS build for the VS Code extension, which
//prepare: npm runs `prepare` when a package is installed from a git ref. That is how
the VS Code extension consumes this one, and a git install ships src/ but no
dist/ — while the extension compiles with tsc against the CommonJS build.
Bun skips lifecycle scripts by default, and the CLI resolves the `bun` export
condition to src/ regardless, so this is a no-op for it.

scripts.check: bun scripts/validate.ts && bun test && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
